_comment: Isolated NetForecast dataset-collection lab. Copy to lab_config.json and edit for your machine. Every scenario target must be inside lab_subnet or the harness refuses to run. See LAB_SETUP.md.

capture._interface_note: Linux VirtualBox host-only is usually vboxnet0; on Windows it is the 'VirtualBox Host-Only Ethernet Adapter' (run 'dumpcap -D' to list).

attacker._ssh_note: Key-based SSH from the lab host into the attacker VM. Scenarios with run_on=attacker execute here.

scenarios.label: Benign
scenarios.command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://{target}/; sleep 2; done

scenarios.label: InitialAccess
scenarios.command: for p in / /login.php /dvwa/ /mutillidae/ '/?id=1'; do curl -s -o /dev/null "http://{target}$p"; sleep 3; done

scenarios.label: LateralMovement
scenarios.command: sshpass -p 'msfadmin' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no msfadmin@{target} 'id; uname -a; ls -la /home' || true

scenarios.label: CommandAndControl
scenarios.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://{target}/; sleep 10; done

scenarios.label: Collection
scenarios.command: sshpass -p 'msfadmin' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no msfadmin@{target} 'tar czf /tmp/loot.tgz /home 2>/dev/null; ls -la /tmp/loot.tgz' || true
